Recommendation: Move the Conditional Access policy requiring MFA for all users out of report-only mode ('enabledForReportingButNotEnforced') and enable enforcement. Worth knowing: a plain 'mfa' builtin control accepts whichever MFA method the user has registered, including weaker ones - an adversary-in-the-middle proxy can tell Entra the current browser doesn't support a passkey and fall back to something weaker, and this control has no way to object. That's a legitimate interim state, not a defect in this rule; once phishing-resistant methods are broadly rolled out, see CA006 for tightening this to a specific authentication strength instead of plain MFA.
